scope: Preserve V8U through V8Y as immutable regressions, audit source-backed high-rate fracture information, and test the V8Y equivalent deformable projectile/facade coupon at predeclared LeMAX values of 50, 100 and 200 mm. The 100 mm medium and fine cases are reused from V8Y. V8Z is not a JT9D, whole-aircraft or global WTC 1 impact model.

evidence_policy.observed_fact: Directly transcribed from a named official document or preserved solver output.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: A result or modelling choice reported by NIST, not an observation of the real event.
evidence_policy.local_archive_claim: No new local-archive claim is used and the source archive is not rescanned.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: The V8Y geometry, material curves, failure strains and LeMAX bracket are simplified numerical assumptions.
evidence_policy.derived_result: A deterministic calculation from the frozen inputs and OpenRadioss outputs.
evidence_policy.unknown: Representative physical internal lengths and high-rate fracture surfaces for the WTC steels and the aircraft engine/cowling remain unidentified.

conclusion.consequence: Only a numerical LeMAX sensitivity can be run. Global, thermal, Blender, explosive and thermite claims remain closed regardless of the numerical result.

regularization_sensitivity.material_law: /MAT/PLAS_JOHNS (LAW2), inherited V8Y curves with EPSmax zero
regularization_sensitivity.failure_model: /FAIL/JOHNSON with inherited constant strains and Ifail_sh=1
regularization_sensitivity.selection: Predeclared factor-two numerical bracket around V8Y LeMAX=100 mm. It is not calibrated to an impulse and is not a physical material-length interval.

nonlocal_regularization.status: predeclared numerical mesh bound, not measured material length
